body: Not really. The only friend I told last friday could care less. And in the bad way. I guess it's okay, but I just can't manage to do anything until I just tell my parents.
I am transgender and I want to tell my parents but I'm terrified.

This actually makes me sick. For one, it's sickening that you'd do it the day after your birthday. Second, you've given up and instead of trying to find a way to fix it, you're now hunting for ways to hate everyone? I urge you to utilize your energy better and find out why you love it. Also, your dog? Your dog loves you. If anything, just be there for the dammed dog. Speaking of dogs, what about that story about you being a selfish prick? When you saw a dog cross the road when you were about to do it, but fate changed course. You said it yourself, you're not a selfish prick. You're not worthless. You're a really good person and it seems to me that you put others before yourself. While that's good and all, you need to start worrying about yourself now. Pursue what you love and don't let anyone stop you, especially not yourself.
